name: StraboMicro2 v2.0.53
notes:
## StraboMicro2 v2.0.53 ### Bug Fixes - Images people bring in are no longer refused over harmless format warnings (Sentry ELECTRON-2P, 2026-10-08, v2.0.52 on macOS: a microscope TIFF, likely Leica LAS X, 'Warning treated as error due to failOn setting / Invalid TIFF directory; tags are not sorted in ascending order'). The tiff library rejects JPEG-compressed (YCbCr) TIFFs, so they go to sharp, whose default failOn 'warning' stopped on the unsorted tags. New electron/sharpInput.js USER_IMAGE_INPUT (limitInputPixels false, failOn 'error') for New Micrograph / batch import conversion, image dimension and validity checks, and images inside an imported .smz; real decoding errors and cut-off files are still refused. npm run test:user-images 11 (Electron; mutations: sharp's default fails the YCbCr TIFF, failOn 'none' lets a cut-off JPEG through) - New Associated Micrograph no longer freezes or crashes when the scale is entered on the Micrograph Location & Scale step (Sentry ELECTRON-2J, 2026-10-08, v2.0.52 on Windows: 'Maximum update depth exceeded' after tracing a scale bar). PlacementCanvas and PointPlacementCanvas told the dialog about the scale data from effects that also re-ran whenever the dialog passed a new callback; NewMicrographDialog makes a new one on every render and stores a new form object each call, so once both values were in (Pixel Conversion Factor, Width/Height, Trace Scale Bar) the two rendered each other without end. The canvases now call their callbacks through refs (new src/hooks/useLatest.ts), so only real input changes re-run the effects. There since 580d814 (2025-11) - Incomplete micrographs dialog: the Needs scale/location/instrument chips sat inside ListItemText's secondary

(React dev warning '

cannot contain a nested

'); secondary now renders as a div. Checked with e2e 13-siblings: warning 1 before, 0 after - Children and spots attached to a hidden XPL are shown (display only, no data change; Daniel Ortega-Arroyo's RGMC1b_5X_XPL carried 5 affine children and a spot nobody could see). Viewer: both PPL and XPL views draw both halves' children (each sized against its own parent's scale; XPL view used to lose the PPL's children) and both halves' spots (XPL view used to show only the PPL's); new spots still go to the PPL. Tree: a PPL lists its hidden XPL's children under the pair as 'On ' (own drag-reorder list), Show/Hide All and Edit All Associated Micrographs Opacity include them, search reveals the PPL for a match below its XPL, the PPL thumbnail reloads with the XPL's. Image export/PDF and composite thumbnails draw the XPL's children on the PPL (scale adjusted by the parents' ratio) and both halves' spots; regenerating an XPL's composite redraws its PPL's. Helpers src/utils/siblingPair.ts, imageExport.pairChildrenOf/getDrawableSpots/primaryOfSecondary; npm run test:sibling-pair 26 (2 mutations caught) --- ### Downloads | Platform | Download | |----------|----------| | macOS (Apple Silicon) | `StraboMicro2-2.0.53-arm64.dmg` | | macOS (Intel) | `StraboMicro2-2.0.53.dmg` | | Windows | `StraboMicro2-Setup-2.0.53.exe` | | Linux (AppImage) | `StraboMicro2-2.0.53.AppImage` | | Linux (Debian) | `strabomicro2_2.0.53_amd64.deb` | ### Installation **macOS**: Download the DMG, open it, and drag StraboMicro2 to your Applications folder. **Windows**: Download and run the installer. name: StraboMicro2 v2.0.52
notes:
## StraboMicro2 v2.0.52

### Bug Fixes
- PPL/XPL siblings: linking an XPL image as the sibling of its PPL image (Link Sibling PPL/XPL Image) now places the XPL exactly where the PPL is. Before, an XPL that had already been placed on its PPL could lose its location when linked, which hid it in the project tree and made Upload to Strabo Server refuse the project with "missing required location". Projects with pairs affected by this are repaired automatically when they are opened
- PPL/XPL siblings: pairing an image placed with affine registration (Link Sibling PPL/XPL Image or Add Corresponding XPL/PPL Image) now copies its affine placement to the sibling
- Project tree: a micrograph that still needs its scale, location or instrument information now shows the warning symbol even before its thumbnail has been made

name: StraboMicro2 v2.0.50
notes:
## StraboMicro2 v2.0.50

### Improvements
- The Windows installer is now code-signed (publisher: Jason Ash), so Windows 11 Smart App Control no longer blocks it
- Micrograph images in PDF reports are limited to 2000 pixels on the long side, which keeps reports of large images to a manageable size (spots and labels keep their proportions)

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed a crash ("out of memory") after viewing many micrographs in one session: images of micrographs you had already left were never released
- Trace Scale Bar no longer runs away or freezes Edit Micrograph Location after you enter a length, and it now warns you instead of silently stopping at a limit when the length gives an unusual scale
- Exporting an .smz to a folder that cannot be written now says Export Failed instead of showing "Exporting..." forever
- Project files are saved safely: a crash in the middle of saving can no longer leave a damaged project.json (the same applies to images replaced from StraboTools)
- You stay logged in when the network or server has a temporary problem; the app reports a connection problem instead of asking you to log in again
- Version History no longer marks unchanged items as modified
- PDF reports no longer add an extra blank page when a page is nearly full
- Associated files: a different file with the same name is no longer mixed up with an existing one, and a file still used elsewhere is no longer deleted
- A damaged saved session no longer opens to "No micrograph loaded"

notes:
## StraboMicro2 v2.0.46

### Important
- **macOS 13 (Ventura) or newer is now required.** Macs on older macOS versions will stay on v2.0.44 and will be told why when checking for updates.

### Improvements
- Updated the app's underlying platform (Electron 44) for security and compatibility, including fixes for image-library vulnerabilities
- File dialogs remember the last folder you used for images, files, and projects
- The macOS installer window displays correctly on macOS 26 (Tahoe)
- Grain detection reports a clear error if its analysis worker fails to start

### Known Issues
- Linux: opening a project by double-clicking an .smz file does not work in this version. Start StraboMicro first, then use File > Open Local Project (.smz).

### Note
- A few interface preferences (dismissed startup message, two panel expand/collapse states) reset once after this update.
